description:
Question: Does the owner accept the authenticated member shell, staff account workflow and documented initial UTC/full-day hourly slot policy?
Artifact: T-002 authenticated shell and the proposed slot-policy documentation.
Criteria: Review account provisioning/reset, login/logout and displayed timezone/hourly assumptions before member booking UI work.
Prerequisites: T-002. Only the booking website ticket waits on this checkpoint; proposed integrity and service work can proceed independently. A later policy change requires corresponding plan updates.
Stage-1 limitation: this is an ordinary ticket; Storybloq does not enforce an owner approval gate.
title: Checkpoint: member shell and slot policy
